access_links.label: Dataset page on the European data portal

description: ROUTE 500® is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. ROUTE 500® was the road database describing 500,000 km of roads in the classified network (motorways, national, departmental) and building elements at national and regional scales. Since the 2019 edition, ROUTE 500® has been the road network of the BD CARTO®. Coverage: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. The publisher named on the listing is Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. Its keywords include bdcarto, donnees-ouvertes, reseaux-de-transport, transports, historique, routes. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, SHAPEFILE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
